records.evidence_slice: The UK National Data Library publishes the Office for National Statistics dataset Wards (May 2025) Boundaries UK BSC (V2). It contains UK ward digital vector boundaries at BSC super-generalised 200m resolution clipped to the coastline. This batch binds the already verified Campden ward code E05009390 to this previously unused BSC V2 source window; no feature geometry or parcel spatial join is materialized.
